CORRECTION (grind session, 2026-11-14 ~02:06 EST, before compute): v1 of the full-remainder primary implemented R_hh with the WRONG SIGN (R_hh = dF - H_hh.u, copied from row 404's D-host diagnostic). The pre-registered gates caught it: G_Rhh_fd failed with rel err EXACTLY 2.00 (analytic H_hh.u is the exact negative of the FD of F_hh) and G_Rtot failed at 2.44e-02. Decisive scaling test (theory/rhh_sign_test_2026-11-14.py): u = eps*e_m; a true remainder is O(eps^2) and scales x4.00 when eps doubles; R_def scales x4.00 (control), R_hh(+1) scales x4.00, R_hh(-1) scales x2.00 (linear-dominated) at three modes. CORRECT: R_hh = (F_hh(u) - F_hh(0)) + H_hh.u (F = -g, F_lin = -H.u, so R = F - F_lin = dF + H.u). Consequence: row 404's D-host ratio |R_hh|/|R_def| = 2.30/2.13 is RETRACTED — that diagnostic measured the linear force (R_true - 2H.u), not the remainder. The TRUE ratios at the SC mid-states are 0.080 (v=0.5) and 0.081 (v=2.0): R_hh is ~8% of R_def, not 2.3x. v2 of the primary implements the + sign everywhere (R_hh_mode, G_Rhh_fd, G_Rtot). The thread's question stands with tempered expectations: whether an 8% force correction closes a 5-6% M_na shortfall.

INTERIM (grind session, 2026-11-14 ~02:45 EST, v2 primary running): G_Rtot FAIL (3.39e-03) is a TEST ARTIFACT, not a dynamics error. Diagnostic (theory/rhh_gtot_diag_2026-11-14.py): drawing q IN the mode span, the identity R_def + R_hh == R_tot holds to 1.3e-12 / 4.9e-13 / 1.4e-13 / 5.4e-14 at |u| = 0.05 / 0.3 / 1.0 / 2.7 -- exact at trajectory scale and beyond.
